compactRecord.rs: One of Japan's top birding sites — winter brings sea eagles and swans; summer brings rare orchids on the Shunkunitai sandbar.

compactRecord.rs: Eerie 'skeleton forest' over sinking salt-water flats — Japan's longest sandbar pointing at Russian Kunashir; surreal birdwatching.
compactRecord.td: 28 km hooked sandspit (Japan's longest) curling into Notsuke Bay opposite Kunashir. The Todowara area is a ghost forest of subsiding salt-killed Sakhalin fir snags; Nature Centre & wooden trail near the tip.

compactRecord.rs: First sunrise in Japan each year; lays Russia's Habomai islands close enough to count waves — politically charged frontier cape.
compactRecord.td: Easternmost publicly accessible point of Japan, on the Nemuro Peninsula. Hokkaidō's oldest lighthouse (1872) and the 'Northern Territories' monument facing the Russian-held Habomai islands ~3.7 km offshore.
